attempts.summary: Published node2's HTTP service (port 8080) on node1's (OPNsense) address at TCP port 80 via a DNAT port-forward with hairpin/NAT-reflection enabled, so node3 (on the same private network as node2) reaches the service through node1's address instead of contacting node2 directly. Also stood up the HTTP service on node2 (none existed) as a persistent systemd unit. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, with boot-identity change and full functional recovery verified after each.
